{{Top}}
'''Ablative plating''' was an enhancement that increased the protection capabilities of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] against many types of damage, particularly from electrical sources. However, the added safegaurd impaired the movement of the wearer to some degree. The Mark I, II, III, & IV versions in turn allowed for a considerable increase in protection without further diminishing movement.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|''KotOR II'']], this upgrade can only be used on medium and heavy armor.
